Initial release.

- Real-time analysis of children's sitting posture using camera input, including estimation of spinal curvature (Cobb angle) and head tilt angle.
- Triggers voice prompts when hunchback (Cobb >10°) or head tilt (>15°) persists beyond a defined threshold.
- Generates structured posture reports with visual metrics and summary, sent to parents.
- Includes strict open-id acquisition and validation process before any analysis or historical report queries.
- Provides historical posture report listing via API, with results shown as Markdown tables containing report links.
- Supports both local and network video inputs; can be integrated with smart desk lamps or study desks.
